strings: r_c shut down rumors about m_c before they could spread, and m_c was grateful.
r_c helped m_c build their nest.
r_c had m_c's back when others were skeptical of the decision to let m_c join the Clan.
m_c took to r_c after {PRONOUN/r_c/subject} offered to show {PRONOUN/m_c/object} around camp via badger-ride.
